title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.0037170835567 by contracting helper 379 on the 234-erasure word
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This construction raises **conditional κ to 0.0037170835567** on the 234-erasure word in #7658. The gain is **0.00000031655885 above that parent’s independently enclosed upper crossing**. DreamingOfClouds’ E2 removed the last read of helper 379 at chart 1065. Deleting its first MOVE and routing 748 → 1072 at the second MOVE removes one paid child from each of the 17 native invocations.

| Exact source | Paid positions before → after | Signed targets | Source invoice crossing | Candidate invoice crossing |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- | --- |
| #7658, 234 erasures | 108,598 → 108,581 | 22,461 | [0.00371676699784, 0.00371676699785] | [0.0037170835568, 0.0037170835569] |
| #7636, 180 erasures | 109,652 → 109,635 | 22,461 | [0.0036807241001, 0.0036807241002] | [0.0036810345257, 0.0036810345258] |

Each word exchanges 17 rank-one and 17 rank-two children for 17 rank-three children. Strict subadditivity gives a saving at every exponent in (0, 1). The full #7658 application uses a conservative claim and an interior probe of 0.00371708355677. The #7636 row gives the crossing under that word’s own signed residual. Its independently checked scalar-width repair and the remaining lower-branch signed obligation are documented in the package. [Proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d12b854d4825e9edfa3a3466909e1abf3525e929/research/p104-role379-idle-stop/PROOF.md)

## Task and overlap

Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The `p104-side-correction` card was refined to a paid native transition on exact #7636 head `7e68d8dd62d9a38c0f3c942262a7a85ca7125b75`, then applied separately on #7658 head `0a0e71c34a5ee5a1b59a8fe7bc6abd35a4d3dd82`. #7630 E6 and #7658 E2 freed the stop. #7639 independently recounted the #7636 parent. #7657 studied a different helper and erasure contract. The bounded scope, alternative 902/1091 result and failed lower-grid check are in the canonical Discussion. A separate attributed prerequisite commit carries ToikY’s five-file #7643 repair for the inherited selected-family CI check. [Coordination and findings](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19695810) · [Source pins](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d12b854d4825e9edfa3a3466909e1abf3525e929/research/p104-role379-idle-stop/SOURCE-PINS.json)

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-role379-idle-stop
```

The registered replay runs two separately implemented word checks and the exact #7113 signed caller. It checks all 1,501 arbitrary-input public rows, every ordered erasure on each word, and all 512 forward and adjoint Gaussian columns of the changed operator with absolute phase. Wrong-chart, equal-invoice sign, self-CLEAR and phase mutations reject. The #7658 signed application regenerated 3,030 catalogue maps, 104 boundaries and 54 strict plus four functional outer predicates. Its outer test includes an algebraic BIT subthreshold check.

Separate paired native runs compared all 1,501 public vectors at two primes, with seven freshly checked ascending frame pairs and 2,952 exact transfers from the earlier full #7641 pair catalogue. Two grid engines agree at `225 × 2^14`. Charging all 51,034 native grid conversions gives **815,821,876 → 815,804,876** ordinary work units with **83,895,232** scalar services per word. A separate full signed process for the unedited parent would repeat 3,029 catalogue keys already covered on the identical frame header. Its invoice was reconstructed from the real caller, and both original and candidate words were run through the paired physical and resource checks. [Reproduction and estimates](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d12b854d4825e9edfa3a3466909e1abf3525e929/research/p104-role379-idle-stop/README.md) · [Application evidence](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d12b854d4825e9edfa3a3466909e1abf3525e929/research/p104-role379-idle-stop/application-evidence/README.md)

## Credit

DreamingOfClouds supplied the two parent words and main-176 pickup substitutions. The #7658 line builds on #7641 and SYLforge’s #7637, Ali Romman’s #7605 and Rohan Arun’s #7113 caller. Clear1nsight prepared the construction and package with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. ChatGPT Pro helped identify the lower-grid failure and the absolute-phase and rounded-error checks. The retained sources carry their original notices.

## Open next questions

Maintainer review should address the all-width rank-three provider, spectator and chart-281 entrance, the complete private extent and same price for all 234 owned lifetimes, and the rounded scalar domain. At candidate clocks 100503–100504 the 457 MOVE feeds a half-coefficient ADD. The stated bound assumes that the provider preserves componentwise divisibility and signed range on admitted states. A total rounded service would need its own verified error and cost bound. The five framework assumptions continue to apply. [Independent scientific review](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d12b854d4825e9edfa3a3466909e1abf3525e929/research/p104-role379-idle-stop/REVIEW.md)
